summary: Mistral released OCR 4, an updated document-parsing model with bounding boxes, block classification, confidence scores, 170-language support, self-hosting, and new API/Document AI pricing.

practices.reason: OCR 4 is a released update with stated benchmark wins, added structural outputs, and multilingual gains that change what document-parsing pipelines should use.
practices.quote: Independent annotators prefer OCR 4 over every leading OCR and document-AI system tested, with win rates averaging 72%, alongside the top overall score on OlmOCRBench (85.20).

practices.reason: The detailed breakdown of benchmark scoring artifacts (ground-truth errors, math notation mismatches, block-attribution issues) informs how a team should interpret OCR benchmark scores rather than take them at face value.
practices.quote: When we audited the mismatches behind our scores, most were not model errors but artifacts of how the benchmarks compare output.

practices.reason: The new API adds structured JSON schema output via Document AI and self-hosting options, requiring integration decisions for teams building document pipelines.
practices.quote: Return structured JSON in a schema you define — pass a JSON schema alongside your document, and the OCR output is fed to mistral-small-2603 to generate content shaped to your spec.
